blocks.brow: Free Live Webinar for Australian C-Suite Executives
blocks.heading: Solving Enterprise Challenges with AI
blocks.description:
In 60 minutes, you'll see the four business problems AI has just made cheap enough to solve, with the case studies and the dollar figures behind them.

Join us for a 50-minute session + 10-minute live Q\&A.\
\
**Thursday 3 September 2026 · 11:00 AM AEST · Live on Zoom**

blocks.heading: What your parked projects cost to build today
blocks.description:
For years the upgrade was too expensive. So were the custom build, the data project and the legacy replacement.

If you sit in the C-suite at an Australian business, someone pitches you on AI most weeks. Few of those pitches show what an AI build costs and returns in a company like yours.

steps.heading: Parked projects worth reopening
steps.description: You'll see what AI-assisted delivery costs for the build you couldn't justify three years ago, and how to spot which shelved roadmap items to pull back out.

steps.heading: Data you can act on, from the systems you already run
steps.description: SSW built executive dashboards in days for three Australian enterprises. You'll see what each one took.

steps.heading: The cost of adding AI to software you already own
steps.description: You'll see real numbers from SSW's Dynamics 365, Salesforce and SAP engagements, including the Australian fintech that cut its per-transaction cost from $120 to $5.

steps.heading: Replace the legacy system rather than patching it
steps.description: Your legacy system breaks every Monday morning. You'll learn to run the numbers on replacing it at today's prices.

blocks.heading: The people who sign off the budget

cards.title: CEOs & Managing Directors
cards.description: Who want to know where their business could save money with AI, and how much.

cards.title: CTOs, CIOs & Heads of Technology
cards.description: Who want to see AI that an Australian engineering team has shipped to production, and what it means for their systems.

cards.title: CFOs & Heads of Strategy
cards.description: Who are building the investment case and need to understand the real costs from Australian engagements.

blocks.heading: See what an AI build costs **and what it returns**
blocks.description: Ulysses brings case studies and costs, with no sales deck. You'll leave knowing which problems you can afford to solve and the expected cost of each.

blocks.heading: Hosted by Ulysses Maclaren
blocks.subtitle:
Ulysses has run the operational side of SSW since 2006, as COO and 2IC to Chief Architect Adam Cogan. He leads the AI work inside SSW's own business: workflow automation, process re-engineering, data-driven decision-making and customer engagement. As Principal Account Manager he also handles the relationships behind SSW's largest client accounts.

On the day he'll take you through the case studies and answer your questions live.

blocks.heading: Seven topics we'll cover in this session

items.heading: The four expensive problems
items.description: How much the cost of solving each one has dropped, and how to price them today.

items.description: Before and after costs from live SSW engagements.

items.description: Deciding between replacement and another year of patching.

items.description: Three questions to ask about your own business this week.

items.heading: Live Q&A: bring your own problem
items.description: Ask Ulysses about a problem in your business.

faqs.question: Will this be recorded?
faqs.answer: Yes. Register and we'll send you the replay even if you can't make it live.

faqs.question: Is this technical?
faqs.answer: No. Ulysses talks cost, time and return for business leaders. You won't see any code.

faqs.question: What size business is this for?
faqs.answer: Mid-to-large Australian enterprises. Come if you have a say in the budget and your business runs custom software, a CRM or ERP, or a legacy system that blocks new features.

faqs.question: How do I join?
faqs.answer: Register on Zoom and you'll get an email with your join link and a calendar invite.

faqs.question: Do I need my camera on?
faqs.answer: No. Attendees aren't required to be on camera. You can ask questions in the Q\&A.

faqs.question: Why is it free?
faqs.answer: We run it to meet business leaders. If you'd like help afterwards, you can book a free 1:1 consultation, with no obligation.
